venue: Maharaja Yadavindra Singh International Cricket Stadium, Mullanpur, New Chandigarh
pitch_text: Pitch and conditions (Mullanpur): Chandigarh hot; brand new square at this modern stadium — only 13 games on this square, scores from 80s to 220s, seven 200+ scores in those games. Grass covering on the surface, odd crack possible; swing for pacers possible; curator says no dew. Dimensions: point ~61m, square leg ~70m, straight ~73m, cow ~74m — one side shorter; high-scoring ground, ~200 par discussed. Touch humid.
notes: Match 29 PBKS vs LSG Mullanpur. LSG won toss, chose to bowl → PBKS bat first (team1 = 1st innings). Impacts: Vijaykumar Vyshak (PBKS), Digvesh Singh Rathi (LSG). Process 1B. Impact pools — LSG: Abdul Samad, digvesh-singh-rathi, Matthew Breetzke, Mayank Yadav, Himmat Singh. PBKS: vijaykumar-vyshak, Harpreet Brar, Suryansh Shedge, Yash Thakur, Vishnu Vinod.
